tree.heading: MBDA Rural Business Center
tree.text: The term “MBDA Rural Business Center” means an MBDA Business Center that provides technical business assistance to minority business enterprises located in rural areas.

tree.heading: MBDA Rural Business Center agreement
tree.text: The term “MBDA Rural Business Center agreement” means an MBDA Business Center agreement that establishes the terms by which the recipient of the Federal assistance award that is the subject of the agreement shall operate an MBDA Rural Business Center.

tree.heading: Minority-serving institution
tree.text: The term “minority-serving institution” means an institution described in any of paragraphs (1) through (7) of section 1067q(a) of title 20.

tree.heading: Rural area
tree.text: The term “rural area” has the meaning given the term in section 1991(a) of title 7.

tree.heading: Rural minority business enterprise
tree.text: The term “rural minority business enterprise” means a minority business enterprise located in a rural area.
